name: Main Entrance
shortDescription: The welcoming gateway where every school day begins.
detailedDescription: The main entrance is the first place visitors and students see. A wide gate opens onto a tree-lined path that leads straight to the Main Building. The welcome arch, the notice board and the security desk make this the starting point of every school day and of our virtual tour.

historicalInformation: Sample: The entrance gate was rebuilt during a campus renovation to make it wider and safer for school buses and visitors.
interestingFacts: The path from the gate leads directly to the Main Building – just follow it to continue the tour.
The notice board near the gate shares announcements, event posters and student achievements.
